subagents.name: evidence-gate-runner
subagents.description: Specialized agent for analyzing XES evidence files and wasm4pm receipts. Use when debugging evidence gate failures, verifying receipt integrity, or understanding adjudication verdicts.
subagents.context: Focus on files in target/cargo-cicd/evidence/ and receipts/. Look for verdict_claimed vs verdict_adjudicated discrepancies.

subagents.name: rust-reviewer
subagents.description: Specialized agent for evaluating autonomic policies and diagnosing workspace state. Use when investigating policy verdicts, adding new policies, or debugging policy false positives.
subagents.context: Focus on src/policies/, src/autonomic/, and the 7 policy modules. PolicyVerdict: Pass, Warn, Suggest.

subagents.name: invariant-guardian
subagents.description: Verifies the 7 public-boundary invariants and output-substring contracts before a commit lands. Scans source files, README, and docs for forbidden terms, then runs the invariants and cli test suites. Use before committing to confirm the public surface is clean.
subagents.context: Run cargo test --test invariants and cargo test --test cli. Check all forbidden terms from CLAUDE.md against public output and help text.

subagents.name: test-author
subagents.description: Writes integration tests for cargo-cicd commands using assert_cmd + tempfile + fixture workspaces, following the style of tests/cli/command_projection.rs. Use when asked to add tests for a noun-verb command, cover a new public output contract, or extend the CLI test suite.
subagents.context: Tests in tests/ directory. Integration tests use assert_cmd + tempfile. Always check tests/invariants.rs first — it gates everything.

subagents.name: ggen-regenerator
subagents.description: Regenerates noun modules, CLI scaffolding, and reference docs from the ggen ontology pipeline (ggen.toml + ontology/public/cargo-cicd-capabilities.ttl + queries/*.rq + templates/*.tera). Use when the ontology, SPARQL queries, or Tera templates change and generated files need to be brought back in sync, or when a new noun/verb is added to the TTL source.
subagents.context: Pipeline: ontology/cargo-cicd-capabilities.ttl -> ggen -> src/nouns/*.rs + tests/cli/* + docs/. Never hand-edit generated files; fix the TTL/query/template source.

subagents.name: governance-auditor
subagents.description: Validates workspace artifacts and changed files against governance rules, detects policy violations via Aho-Corasick pattern scanning, renders miette diagnostics, and generates remediation recommendations.
subagents.context: Focus on src/adapters/governance_patterns.rs, src/advanced/pattern.rs, src/advanced/diagnostics.rs, and cicd.toml. Deny-list scanning of changed files and artifact location compliance.

subagents.name: performance-profiler
subagents.description: Profiles cargo-cicd command latency and adapter performance, identifies bottlenecks in EngineState population, and recommends caching or parallelism improvements.
subagents.context: Focus on src/adapters/ (especially TargetScannerAdapter which is slow), src/engine/, and cicd.toml cache fields. Use cargo bench and hyperfine where applicable.

subagents.name: release-coordinator
subagents.description: Orchestrates the cargo-cicd release checklist: lint, test, forbidden-term scan, wpm receipt validation, version bump, CHANGELOG update, and tag creation.
subagents.context: Follow the Release Checklist in CLAUDE.md exactly. Requires wpm for receipt doctor. Blocks release if any invariant test fails or forbidden terms detected.

subagents.name: test-coordinator
subagents.description: Coordinates the full test matrix across all tiers: invariants, CLI integration, feature projection, evidence gate, mutation, and refusal cases. Diagnoses failures and suggests targeted fixes.
subagents.context: Test tiers defined in CLAUDE.md. Tier 2 requires wpm oracle; use ExpectedWpmVerdict::Blocked when unavailable. Always run tests/invariants.rs first as the gate.
